messages:
Mira: tiny PSA: Marigold (guinea pig) discovered an empty takeaway soup bowl and has officially declared it a hammock. photo incoming. :heart_eyes:
Owen: must see. guinea pig hammock is peak domestic engineering. :ok_hand:
Mira: uploaded an image: https://i.imgur.com/MarigoldHammock.jpg — look at that relaxed toothy grin. she refuses to be lifted. :joy:
Leah: that is an aristocat-level loaf but in pig form. also the tiny blanket tucked in is chef's kiss. :sparkles:
Owen: poll idea: should we start a micro-gallery for "best container naps"? options: Yes / Only if judged by Marigold / No, my cat will be jealous
ops-bot: Poll created: "Container naps gallery?" Options: Yes / Marigold judge / No. 6 votes so far.
Dan: donating a tiny ribbon for ceremonial hammock inauguration. :ribbon:
Mira: will post a short album later. Marigold sends a muffled snort and a soft nose-boop. <3
